description: Implementation of the MasqueServerBackend class handling MASQUE protocol requests, backend client registration, IP address management, and request processing within the quic namespace.

classes.name: MasqueServerBackend
classes.description: Handles MASQUE protocol requests, backend client management, and IP address allocation.

methods.name: MasqueServerBackend
methods.description: Constructor initializing backend with mode, authority, and cache directory.

methods.name: MaybeHandleMasqueRequest
methods.description: Processes MASQUE requests based on headers and request handler.

methods.name: FetchResponseFromBackend
methods.description: Fetches response, handling MASQUE requests or delegating to memory cache backend.

methods.name: HandleConnectHeaders
methods.description: Handles CONNECT headers, processing MASQUE requests or delegating.

methods.name: CloseBackendResponseStream
methods.description: Closes the response stream for a request.

methods.name: RegisterBackendClient
methods.description: Registers a backend client with a connection ID.

methods.name: RemoveBackendClient
methods.description: Removes a backend client associated with a connection ID.

methods.name: GetNextClientIpAddress
methods.description: Generates the next client IP address in the specified range.
